title: p0273
universal_lens: The structural unification rests on the topological invariance of geodesics under non-Euclidean projection manifolds. While metric properties like angles and distances are highly observer-dependent, the affine property of straightness remains invariant across spatial transmutations, forming a robust geometric kernel for state-space modeling.
gsi_mapping: In GSI, this maps to conformal Bayesian inference where posterior probability densities shift dynamically with observational priors (changing apparent sizes), yet the underlying latent causal trajectories remain strictly linear. The model rejects spurious curvature in high-dimensional feature spaces unless supported by infinite-precision alignment.
gse_mapping: For GSE situational reasoning, player trajectories are modeled as objective straight lines. Even when projected onto fragmented defensive surfaces creating solid angles, the engine's state-transition matrices preserve the linearity of intent, preventing false 'kinks' in predictive pathing algorithms.

primitives.name: Metric Covariance Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: Objective corners are ever changing their angles to the eyes, spaces their apparent size, lines their distance.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: Angles: radians (rad); Apparent size: dimensionless ratio; Distance: meters (m). All are functions of observer position vector r_obs.
primitives.assumptions: Euclidean physical space observed via perspective projection; continuous differentiability of the visual field.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Singularities occur at the exact location of the object (r -> 0) or at optical occlusion boundaries.

layer2.mapping: Maps directly to dynamic sensor noise models in GSI, where raw telemetry features fluctuate based on camera/observer geometry.
layer2.telemetry: Variance of angular measurements across distributed tracking cameras.

primitives.name: Affine Invariance Kernel
primitives.verbatim_quote: But by no transmutation of position in space does an objective straight line appear bent, and only in one position out of an infinity does a broken line look straight.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: Curvature k: inverse meters (m^-1); Position: meters (m). Straightness implies k = 0.
primitives.assumptions: Rigid body kinematics; absence of gravitational lensing or extreme relativistic effects; idealized pinhole projection.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Breaks down if the observer undergoes non-linear acceleration during integration, or if the line itself is physically deforming.

layer2.mapping: Forms the core constraint solver in GSE, ensuring that predicted ball/player paths maintain zero intrinsic curvature regardless of rendering perspective.
layer2.telemetry: Residual error of linear regression fits on tracked object centroids over time windows.

primitives.name: Topological Projection Preservation
primitives.verbatim_quote: of a straight line upon two surfaces which make a solid angle with each other to give the line itself a sensible 'kink.' Look with it at the corner of your room: the after-image, which may overlap all three surfaces of the corner, still continues straight.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: Solid angle: steradians (sr); Surface normals: dimensionless vectors n_1, n_2.
primitives.assumptions: The perceptual manifold overlays the physical discontinuity without inheriting its boundary conditions; cognitive interpolation is globally optimal.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Fails when the solid angle exceeds perceptual integration limits or when surface textures actively disrupt continuity cues.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to GSE's zone-crossing logic, where a player's trajectory crossing from Zone A to Zone B does not introduce artificial momentum loss or directional bias.
layer2.telemetry: Continuity of velocity vectors across defined spatial partition boundaries.
